referral.reason: Evaluation of intermittent attention difficulty during demanding work activities.

alternative_explanations.assessment: May account for occasional attention variability.

informants.summary: The patient reports occasional distraction during lengthy work but generally completes daily responsibilities independently.
Clinical interview does not identify a persistent cross-setting pattern.

examples: Loses track of deadlines when several tasks compete for attention.
Needs written reminders for multi-step responsibilities.
Attention decreases during lengthy independent work.
Fidgets when seated for extended periods.
Sometimes has difficulty waiting during group activities.
